robot_description2: It was years ago when a white giant, engrossed in battle with a great evil, fell to Earth from the stars, crashing onto a Wily base in the pacific. Wily took hold of a parasitic and powerful energy source, while Light instead began repairs on the giant. After repairing the alien being, it suddenly awoke and launched to the skies, hellbent on eliminating the evil energy - this is the sworn duty of Duo, star marshal, sworn protector of the universe. Sensing Mega Man's strong sense of justice, he formed an alliance with Earth's hero, and together they wiped Earth of the foreign evil energy plaguing the lands. So very little data has been recorded on Duo, and yet what little he's shown of his power far surpasses that of anything else on the database. What is known is that Duo's mighty hand is able to contain and destroy evil energy, and that he's clearly able to utilize a great energy of his own. Since fulfilling his duty on Earth, he has yet to return - and best that he has no reason to.
robot_quotes_start: Greetings, everyone -- Allow me to lend my strength.
robot_quotes_victory: Have faith in justice, and we may still be able to save your planet yet.
